sentences.text: Llanosuchus is a reptile belonging to the parent group Notosuchia.

This genus was described by Fiorelli et al. in 2016 from fossils found in the Late Cretaceous Los Llanos Formation in Argentina. Only one fossil occurrence of Llanosuchus has been recorded, and the genus contains only a single species, L. tamaensis.
Llanosuchus lived during the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
